chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Said from Ibn Abi Najran from Muhammad ibn Humran said,
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: "The time for the prayer of the eclipse is not during the hour in which the eclipse occurs at sunrise, nor during the hour in which it occurs at sunset."
And Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: "It is an obligatory duty."
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling and timing for the Islamic eclipse prayer?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) specifies that the time for Salat al-Kusuf corresponds precisely to the duration of the eclipse at sunrise or sunset, establishing it as a mandatory obligation (fard). This ruling, recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, underscores the prayer’s status as a communal act of worship and reflection on divine signs, distinct from the optional Sunnah prayers performed at other times.
